chunks: Those among the migrants (from Makkah) and helpers (in Madina) who were the first to believe, and those who followed them in goodness, have been accepted by God and they follow His way. For them He has gardens with streams of running water where they will abide for ever; and that is happiness supreme.
ai.seo_question: Who are the Sabiqun al-Awwalun and what is their reward in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the hierarchy of the Sahaba, with the 'Sabiqun al-Awwalun' (the earliest forerunners) holding the highest rank of divine pleasure (ridwan). The reciprocal satisfaction between God and the believers underscores the spiritual purity of the Muhajirun and Ansar, while the promise of eternal gardens serves as the ultimate reward for their steadfastness in the early community.
